CommissionCard.description:
Canon §6.3 Commission card + Canon §6.4 verdict entry point.

Every governed value confirmed explicitly here before commit. On
commit, the card produces a CommissionVerdict (sibling contract).

committed_at_iso.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the commit action. None until commit.
committed_at_iso.title: Committed At Iso

values_confirmed.description: Reflection field names that have been explicitly confirmed on this card.
values_confirmed.title: Values Confirmed

verdict_ref.description: Trust-receipt ref for the CommissionVerdict issued on commit.
verdict_ref.title: Verdict Ref

CommissionCard.title: CommissionCard

DialogueTurn.description:
One turn in the wizard conversation.

Canon §6.3: dialogue is the shaping channel; the card commits. Turns
are read-only after write; the card holds the committed state.

ts_iso.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the turn.
ts_iso.title: Ts Iso

DialogueTurn.title: DialogueTurn

DialogueTurnRole.description:
A conversational turn's speaker.

`user`   — the operator.
`agent`  — the wizard agent (through the SyniSense Shield chokepoint).
DialogueTurnRole.title: DialogueTurnRole

Door.description:
Canon §6.1 — three doors on the Use Data landing.

Same conversational wizard behind each; door is intent seed only.
Door.title: Door

FieldState.description:
Canon §6.3 Reflection card — three field states per governed value.

`set`     — a user-said value confirmed on the Commission card.
`open`    — never named yet; render "— open" (never a placeholder).
`assumed` — agent-supplied; carries the amber "agent assumed" chip.
FieldState.title: FieldState

IntelCard.description:
Canon §6.3 Intel card — what the shield's grounded turn returned.

Names the source of every claim rendered in the conversation; unset
when no grounded claim has landed yet.

unset.description: True when no grounded claim has been served yet.
unset.title: Unset

IntelCard.title: IntelCard

PlanPreviewCard.description:
Canon §6.3 Plan preview — ranges + editable ceiling with halt note.

Renders capacity, coverage, and cost ranges. Ceiling is editable inline.

ceiling_usd.description: Operator-set ceiling for this objective's spend.
ceiling_usd.title: Ceiling Usd

halt_note_verbatim.const: Halts at ceiling. A halted run resumes only after you raise it or narrow the objective.
halt_note_verbatim.default: Halts at ceiling. A halted run resumes only after you raise it or narrow the objective.
enum: Halts at ceiling. A halted run resumes only after you raise it or narrow the objective.
halt_note_verbatim.title: Halt Note Verbatim

PlanPreviewCard.title: PlanPreviewCard

ReflectionCard.description:
Canon §6.3 Reflection card — always visible.

Renders the objective as it stands. Fields declare state; no field
silently commits from dialogue (gate_card_commits_no_silent_dialogue_values).
ReflectionCard.title: ReflectionCard

ReflectionField.description:
One governed value on the Reflection card.

Canon §6.3 Reflection: "the objective as it stands now, fields marked
set / open / assumed default". Every field carries its state.

committed_by_ref.description: turn_id of the DialogueTurn that committed this value on the Commission card. None while state==open. For assumed values, the turn that surfaced the assumption.
committed_by_ref.title: Committed By Ref

label.description: Plain-language label rendered on the card.
label.title: Label

value.description: Concrete value when state==set or state==assumed. None when state==open.
value.title: Value

ReflectionField.title: ReflectionField

SampleResultsCard.description:
Canon §6.3 Sample results — the receipt of a completed test.

Renders volume, class distribution, per-hour cost from an executed
sample; grounded (trust-receipt ref stamped).

grounded_by_receipt_ref.description: Trust receipt ID of the sample run that grounds these numbers.
grounded_by_receipt_ref.title: Grounded By Receipt Ref

SampleResultsCard.title: SampleResultsCard

TestCard.description:
Canon §6.3 Test card — offer, not push.

Sample-run governed by the objective's budget; result promotable to
Reflection in one action (Canon §6.3 winning-config promote).

last_run_ref.description: Trust-receipt ref for the most recent sample run. None until first run.
last_run_ref.title: Last Run Ref

winning_config_promoted.description: True after operator promotes the winning config to Reflection.
winning_config_promoted.title: Winning Config Promoted

TestCard.title: TestCard

description:
Canon §6.2 · §6.3 · §11.1 — the conversational wizard session envelope.

Envelope carrying:
  * the door (entry intent),
  * the dialogue as an append-only turn list,
  * the six cards' state,
  * the session identity (session_id + operator_id).

Design law:
  * Dialogue shapes; the card commits.
  * Every governed value on the Commission card was explicitly
    confirmed (not silently inferred from a turn).
  * Agent-said values carry `state="assumed"` (amber chip) on
    Reflection until the operator confirms.

Freeze: `model_json_schema()` matches
`tests/invariants/use_data_wizard_session.contract_snapshot.json`
byte-for-byte.

commission.description: None until the operator opens the Commission card.

door.description: Which of the three landing doors seeded this session.

operator_id.description: User id of the operator running the wizard.
operator_id.title: Operator Id

session_id.description: Stable UUID for this wizard session.
session_id.title: Session Id

title: UseDataWizardSession
